# Will Sussman (R): NYS Assembly, District 4

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Will Sussman's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://vote.sussman4ny.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Rebecca Kassay](../kassay-rebecca/) (D).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/sussman-william> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A biography plus a sharp claim about his opponent. The greenway claim misstates the bill: Kassay's A8560 would have given the MTA an easement over part of DOT land for a rail yard, and it was vetoed. Her later bill, which permanently protects the trail, was signed into law. His MIT credential is unclear: court records describe him leaving an MIT PhD program.

1. The greenway attack describes a vetoed bill and leaves out the law that replaced it.
2. He is a Yeshiva University adjunct and an antisemitism activist, per press coverage.
